sources.name: Tournament decklists (Magic Online)
sources.note: Last 42 days, a list counting half as much for every 14 days since it was played. Magic Online: 60 tournaments, 686 lists from Challenges and other events, 153 from leagues. A league shows only its 5-0 lists, so one counts a third. Named with the rules of Badaro/MTGOFormatData. This is tournament play, mostly best of three, not the Arena ladder.
